reading.title: The Kickball Feud
reading.purpose: Watch two rival classes go from fighting over a field to playing as allies.
paras: For weeks, Room 12 and Room 14 had a feud, a long and bitter fight, over the best kickball field. It began when Room 14 marched onto the grass early and said it was theirs. Room 12 felt the field had been invaded, and the two classes clashed at every recess.

On Monday, Room 12 tried a plan. Their captain, Imani, sent half the team around the back to take first base. Room 14 pushed them away, and the Room 12 players had to retreat, moving back behind the fence. By Friday, neither class could defeat the other. The games ended in a stalemate, a standoff where nobody could move ahead.

Then Room 9 arrived with a new rule: only one class could use the field at a time. Both captains groaned. Their shirts clashed, too. Room 12 wore orange and Room 14 wore red, and together they looked like a sunset gone wrong.

Behind the bus, Imani spoke with Dev, the captain of Room 14. "If we keep fighting, nobody wins," she said. "Let us make a pact, a serious promise to share the field." Dev did not want to surrender, but he did not want to lose recess either. "Fine," he said. "You are my ally, not my enemy."
The next week, the two classes formed an alliance, joining together as one team against Room 9. They lost by a single run, but nobody minded.

choices: a game that one class wins by a single run
a rule that lets only one class use the field
a plan to take first base from the other team
a standoff where nobody can move ahead
qs.why: The text explains it: a stalemate is "a standoff where nobody could move ahead."

qs.q: Which sentence shows that Dev did not want to give up easily?
choices: Dev did not want to surrender, but he did not want to lose recess either.
Behind the bus, Imani spoke with Dev, the captain of Room 14.
The next week, the two classes formed an alliance, joining together as one team against Room 9.
qs.why: This sentence says Dev did not want to surrender, so he was not ready to give up.

ev.text: Dev did not want to surrender, but he did not want to lose recess either.

qs.q: Why did Imani suggest a pact?
choices: She wanted to join the team that Room 9 was building.
She was afraid that Dev would tell a teacher about her plan.
She saw that fighting meant that nobody would win.
She had lost every game by a very large score.
qs.why: Imani says, "If we keep fighting, nobody wins," so she offers a promise to share the field.

qs.q: What is the best summary of this story?
choices: Room 9 wins every kickball game against both of the other classes.
Two rival classes stop fighting and learn to share a field.
A captain is punished for taking first base without permission.
Two classes change their shirt colors so they will not clash again.
qs.why: The classes fight over the field, make a pact, and end up playing together.

clues.text: a serious promise to share the field
